title: Every change to a check is saved whole, versioned and kept
statement: Every change to a check MUST be written to the product's data files whole or not at all, so a refused change leaves every file as it was; it MUST survive a restart, be versioned in git with the rest of the repo, and MUST NOT be lost or left half written by a crash in the middle of a write.

title: The space chosen last is kept in this browser, each space's last page for the session
statement: The space the Reader chose last SHOULD be kept in this browser from one launch to the next, and each space's last page MUST be kept only while the browser session lasts.

title: What is folded in the nav is kept for the browser session alone
statement: Which nav entries the Reader has open or folded MUST be kept while the browser session lasts, and MUST NOT outlive it.

title: A window's tabs are kept for the window's session alone
statement: A window's tabs, each with its place, MUST be kept while the window's session lasts, and open again with it; they MUST NOT outlive it.

title: The session's settings are kept for the browser session alone
statement: The session's settings MUST be kept in session storage while the browser session lasts, shared by its pages, and MUST NOT outlive it: nothing of them is written to local storage.

title: Record summaries keep up with each change without a stall
statement: When the record summaries are read again, only the records that differ from the last reading MUST be indexed anew, every unchanged record kept as it was, and the problems and the coverage MUST each be indexed only when their own reading answers, so that no change leaves the Reader waiting more than 50 ms; what is kept MUST equal what indexing every reading afresh gives.

title: The product repo's config is kept whole beside its data
statement: The product repo's config MUST be kept at the repo's root, versioned with the rest of the repo, and written whole; a repo without one MUST read as having none, and one that cannot be read MUST be refused with what is wrong.

title: The shell settings are kept across launches as the person last wrote them
statement: The shell settings MUST be kept in the shell's user data folder across launches, read again whole on each load so a change the person made by hand counts, and written whole; settings that cannot be read MUST fall back to the defaults.

title: The person's key bindings are kept in this browser
statement: The keys a person bound SHOULD be kept in this browser's local storage from one launch to the next; losing them (cleared or blocked storage) MUST cost only the bindings, every shortcut falling back to its defaults.

title: The person's voice settings are kept in this browser
statement: The voice settings SHOULD be kept in this browser's local storage from one launch to the next; losing them (cleared, blocked or malformed storage) MUST cost only the settings, both modes falling back to off and the wake phrase to its default.

title: A folder's chat mode is kept across launches, the chats only while the shell runs
statement: Each folder's chat mode MUST be kept in the shell's user data folder across launches and read back for the folder's next chat, leaving out the default; the chats themselves and the stops in progress MUST be kept only while the shell runs.

title: A panel's size and whether it shows are kept in this browser
statement: Each panel's size and whether it shows SHOULD be kept in this browser's local storage from one launch to the next; losing them (cleared or blocked storage) MUST cost only the choice, and the app MUST work on without storage.

title: The person's themes and choices are kept in this browser
statement: The person's own themes, the chosen theme, the color mode and Scroll to zoom SHOULD be kept in this browser's local storage from one launch to the next; losing them MUST cost only the choice, falling back to the built-in themes, the system's mode and scroll panning.

title: A window's place is kept across launches
statement: A window's place (its folder's bounds, maximized or filling the display) MUST be kept in the shell's user data folder across launches, written whole so a crash never leaves it half written; a place that cannot be read MAY be dropped for the default place.

title: A window's server is kept only while the shell runs
statement: The server each open window loads Lathe from MUST be kept only in the shell's memory while it runs; nothing of the running server MAY outlive a quit but its port (SR02), and each window MUST start or find its server again on the next launch.

title: Each folder's server keeps its port across launches
statement: The port each folder's server last listened on MUST be kept in the shell's user data folder and asked for again on the next launch, so the view keeps its origin and with it the person's saved choices (theme, key bindings, panels and scroll to zoom). When that port is taken the server MAY take a free one, which costs only those choices.

title: The recent folders are kept across launches
statement: The recent folders, latest first, MUST be kept in the shell's user data folder across launches, written whole so a crash never leaves half a file; a missing file MAY read as an empty list.
